title: Computation, not weight access: large language models as auditors of clinical prediction networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.07847v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) have been reported to read, edit and write the weights of small neural networks, raising the prospect of auditing clinical prediction models from their files alone. Public demonstrations, however, mixed reading raw weights with running code. We separated these conditions in internally pre-specified simulation experiments. Tanh networks of 105 to 38,401 weights were trained on simulated cohorts of patients with subarachnoid haemorrhage, each with a planted relationship or none, and one network was trained on labels that under-recorded deaths in a subgroup. GPT-6 Astra and four other GPT models answered single prompts under a default or an explicit system instruction, either with the weights in the prompt and no tools, or with a calculation-only tool that exposed the weights (white box) or only the network's predictions (black box). Without tools, Astra recovered planted relationships in 353-weight n

translated_title: 计算而非权重访问：大语言模型作为临床预测网络的审计者
translated_abstract: 据报道，前沿大语言模型（LLM）能够读取、编辑和编写小型神经网络的权重，这为仅凭模型文件审计临床预测模型提供了可能。然而，公开演示中将读取原始权重与运行代码混在了一起。我们在内部预先设定的模拟实验中将这些条件区分开来。研究在模拟的蛛网膜下腔出血患者队列上训练了具有105至38,401个权重的Tanh网络，每个网络中植入了一个关系或不植入任何关系，其中一个网络所使用的标签在某个亚组中少记了死亡人数。GPT-6 Astra和其他四个GPT模型在默认或明确的系统指令下回答单个提示，条件为：提示中包含权重且不使用工具，或者使用仅能进行计算的工具，该工具或暴露权重（白盒），或仅暴露网络的预测（黑盒）。在不使用工具的情况下，Astra在353权重网络中恢复了植入的关系
tldr: 通过预先设定的模拟实验，该研究发现在没有计算工具时仅凭提示中的原始权重无法可靠恢复植入的关系，表明大语言模型审计临床预测网络的关键在于计算能力（借助工具访问权重或预测）而非直接的权重访问。
en_tdlr: Through pre-specified simulation experiments, this study shows that LLMs' ability to audit clinical prediction networks depends on computation via tools rather than direct weight access, as raw weights alone in prompts are insufficient to reliably recover planted relationships.
